verdict.rationale: Fathom's own docs say AI summaries are instantly available after each call, along with AI-generated action items that cover next steps. Advanced and custom call summaries are also offered, and summaries can be retrieved per recording via API or pushed by webhook. missing for 10: explicit documentation that summaries are structured into key points and decisions, evidence that summaries are shareable without editing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
